subject: Procurement path & timeline for AcmeCloud — next steps / MAP
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Sofia Alvarez <sofia.alvarez@acmecloud.com>
Cc: Tom Bennett <tom.bennett@acmecloud.com>
Date: Wed, 4 Mar 2026 10:15:00 -0700
Subject: Procurement path & timeline for AcmeCloud — next steps / MAP

Hi Sofia — great to meet earlier. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we can align with your procurement flow.

Call recap:
- Primary goal: pilot Redwood inference for internal search/ranking on Q2 traffic (100M tokens/month estimate).
- Primary constraints: data residency + SOC2 evidence for security review; finance needs PO/net30.

Questions we need to confirm from your side:
1) Preferred commercial path: direct PO (preferred by finance) vs company marketplace (if you use an internal marketplace vendor) vs card?
2) Procurement milestones & approximate durations for each gate: legal review -> security review -> finance/PO issuance.
3) Any internal docs we should prep (SOW template, vendor questionnaire, invoicing contact).

Proposed MAP (attached: Redwood-MAP-v1.xlsx):
- Week 0: finalize commercial path & pricing (this thread)
- Week 1: legal review (redlines handled by both counsels)
- Week 2: security review (SOC2 + DFD + encryption docs)
- Week 3: finance PO issuance and onboarding

Attachments: Redwood-MAP-v1.xlsx, Redwood-pricing-sheet.csv

Can you confirm whether AcmeCloud will be going PO vs marketplace? If PO, do you have an estimated date for PO issuance (we usually see 2-4 weeks from start of legal). If marketplace, we can engage the marketplace team but need to know early so we can prep the package.

Happy to sync for 30 minutes — I can drop a slot tomorrow if that helps.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Senior Sales Manager | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com | (415) 555-0123
Redwood Inference
From: Sofia Alvarez <sofia.alvarez@acmecloud.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Bennett <tom.bennett@acmecloud.com>, Procurement <procurement@acmecloud.com>
Date: Thu, 5 Mar 2026 09:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Procurement path & timeline for AcmeCloud — next steps / MAP

Thanks Marissa — really helpful summary. Quick answers below and a rough timeline so you can slot things in.

Commercial path: We plan to use a direct PO (finance prefers PO over card). We are not planning to go through the internal marketplace for this pilot.

Proposed internal cadence (estimates):
- Legal review: ~1 week (starting next Tue)
- Security review: ~2 weeks (they need SOC2 + DFD + vendor questionnaire answers)
- Finance / PO issuance: ~1 week after approvals (PO issuance target by 2026-03-25)

Procurement contact: procurement@acmecloud.com (I've CC'd them). Finance lead: Tom Bennett (cc).

Attached is our procurement checklist (Acme-procurement-checklist.pdf) — it lists required artifacts and preferred invoice fields. We typically ask for net30 payment terms; please confirm if that works.

We'd like to schedule the security Q&A with your team the week of Mar 9 — does that work for your security/solutions folks?

Thanks,
Sofia Alvarez
Head of Product Operations | AcmeCloud
sofia.alvarez@acmecloud.com
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Sofia Alvarez <sofia.alvarez@acmecloud.com>, Procurement <procurement@acmecloud.com>
Cc: camila_reyes@redwood.com, marcus_lin@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 6 Mar 2026 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Procurement path & timeline for AcmeCloud — next steps / MAP

Thanks Sofia — PO + net30 is fine from our side. Appreciate the checklist.

Camila and Marcus — looping you both in for any legal/security asks and to align on MAP. I’ve updated the MAP (attached) to reflect AcmeCloud’s timeline and milestones (legal start next Tue, security week of Mar 9).

Camila — can your team share the SOC2, DFD, and vendor questionnaire answers before the security Q&A? We can also prepare a short SOW template if procurement needs it for the PO.

Sofia — if you can confirm a few 30-min windows for the security Q&A (Mar 9-11), I’ll get Camila and one of our security engineers on the invite.

Attachments: Redwood-MAP-v1.xlsx (updated)

Cheers,
Marissa
From: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.com>
To: Sofia Alvarez <sofia.alvarez@acmecloud.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: marcus_lin@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 9 Mar 2026 08:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Procurement path & timeline for AcmeCloud — next steps / MAP

Hi Sofia + Marissa — quick note from the security/solutions side.

We can provide the following artifacts ahead of the security Q&A:
- SOC 2 Type II summary (redacted)
- Data flow diagram (DFD) and high-level architecture diagram
- Encryption and key management overview (KMS/HSM options)
- Completed vendor security questionnaire (I can fill the Acme checklist you attached)

Suggested MAP updates / mutual actions:
- Action: Redwood to send SOC2 + DFD + questionnaire answers — target 2026-03-10
- Action: Security Q&A (30m) — proposed slots: Tue 2026-03-10 09:00-09:30 PT, Wed 2026-03-11 11:00-11:30 PT, Thu 2026-03-12 14:00-14:30 PT
- Action: Legal counsel exchange & redlines — target 2026-03-17
- Action: Finance to issue PO — target 2026-03-25

Attachments I will send in a follow-up: SOC2-summary.pdf, DFD-acme.pdf, Vendor-questionnaire-completed.pdf

If any of those dates are tight, let me know and we can compress where feasible.

Best,
Camila Reyes
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
camila_reyes@redwood.com
From: Sofia Alvarez <sofia.alvarez@acmecloud.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Bennett <tom.bennett@acmecloud.com>, Procurement <procurement@acmecloud.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Mar 2026 16:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Procurement path & timeline for AcmeCloud — next steps / MAP

Perfect — thanks Camila and team. Those deliverables and slots work for us. We’ll plan to do the security Q&A on Tue 2026-03-10 09:00 PT.

A few quick confirmations:
- Commercial path: direct PO, net30
- Marketplace: Not using
- PO target: 2026-03-25 (we’ll update if anything slips)
- SOW: procurement says optional for pilot; if Redwood prefers we can include a brief SOW on the PO.

Procurement will be expecting invoice details and the Redwood billing contact — please send to procurement@acmecloud.com.

Thanks — looking forward to the Q&A.

Sofia
